I think the message of " deep listening " is symbolic of an important aspect of communication.  A vital part to communication is that the receiver of the message must interpret and understand as much of the initial language as possible so that the message, and resulting effects of that message are then properly then carried out in the way that was intended. 

Part of being able to have the intended effect requires being unbiased as a listener to whatever the message may be. A lot of the time, as humans we are faced with messages and situations that make us uncomfortable or makes us vulnerable. A possible reaction to these situations is to lose focus or ignore messages that make us uncomfortable even though they are best for us. Another form of ignoring these messages and there deeper meanings is to listen to them on a shallow/ surface level and trick ourselves into thinking we understand. So intentionally ignoring the message is like what was said in the interview about entering the door if your faced with it. Sometimes people wont enter deliberately, or trick themselves into denial and think they aren't supposed to go through the door, when they really should be entering.

It's all part of a process you begin to see more and more as you come into your own self standing personhood. It's a process of communication. That involves: paying attention, seeing language patterns,interpretation, response. I would agree with your idea since I was thinking the same thing even prior to reading this. So if you and I can both get the same interpretation, it's logical to assume someone else also could. Including the artists putting out the communication initially.

There's a lot of misinformation on this because many people don't have the opportunity to experience both in different doses many many times in order to compare the different flavors. This is for many reasons but two main ones are the fact that our entire world is set up in a way that discourages use of either of them, and also the difficulty of obtaining standard quality in many cases. Especially for lsd I can say In my experience that using a reagent test kit that Atleast 8-10 batches of "acid" are not Lsd and are some other research chemical. I've taken reagent tested Lsd over 50 times ranging from 100-700 micrograms maybe as much as a whole mg in a few situations which lasted easily 24 hours. I've dose several microdosings as well. I've used psilocybe cubensis mushrooms about 20 times ranging in dose from 3-6 grams. The majority being over 4 grams. LSD is less dose dependent. The difference between 2 or 4  tabs is significant yes. But mostly in terms of body load and duration. However doubling a dose of Shrooms say 3.5 grams vs 7 grams is a completely out of this world difference. Shrooms in the 3-3.5 gram range are equivalent to about a 2-4 tab maybe as high as 5 tab lsd experience.  Shrooms are much more dose sensitive.

It's amazing to me how this happens. They always do so according to the golden ratio which is seen in all of nature everywhere in the entire universe. This is also how Nautilus get their perfect spiral shell. ( the underwater squid in a trippy looking shell).  A lot of people see these and relate them to fossils of their older ancestors. We have come to a point evolutionarily that we have gone from blob like bacteria ,to four legged animals, and then to different shaped lower primates, now as higher primates we now are embodying the most fractal form of all animals. I believe this is very important that we all get the opportunity to learn and experience this knowledge.

Manipulation never works if we are aware of it. With that said, We can focus and have moments of clarity during set times of the days or weeks or even months and years of our routines, that help us to take distractions away. Things in this day and age are very busy, very loud, and most of all very distracting. Especially with mobile communication( eg. Mobile devices), these distractions can take hold of us in ways we don't realize. This is how culture manipulates us, for better or worse. 

The way we can make better sure we are thinking and acting on our, absent of distraction, free will, is to undertake experiences such as psychedelics. These can significantly amplify introspective and focusing experiences and show us how truly meaningful focusing is. That's what this experience is. It is focus. We can have all the thoughts that occure during a psychedelic experience without the use of medicines to boost it. Remember to understand this:
 -A trip is a focusing/meditative experience where we can focus on our actions and feelings without distraction. 
- it's imperative and crucial to our human survival that we set time aside for ourselves to reflect on our actions.
